mapper.insert: INSERT INTO students (full_name, furigana, nickname, email, city, age, gender,remark,is_deleted) VALUES(#{fullName}, #{furigana}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{city}, #{age}, #{gender}, #{remark}, false)
mapper.update: UPDATE students SET full_name = #{fullName}, furigana = #{furigana}, nickname = #{nickname}, email = #{email}, city = #{city}, age = #{age}, gender = #{gender}, remark = #{remark}, is_deleted = #{deleted} WHERE id = #{id}
